title: Luxury 46 Yacht Private Captained Boat Tours
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience Miami in comfort and style aboard your private Sunseeker 46ft yacht, designed for luxury, relaxation, and unforgettable ocean views.

We offer flexible 2, 3, and 4-hour private charters, along with a specially timed sunset cruise that captures Miami’s golden hour at its best.

Cruise through the sparkling waters of Biscayne Bay as you take in panoramic views of the Miami skyline, glide past the Port of Miami, and admire the exclusive waterfront estates of Star Island and Fisher Island. As the sun sets, the sky comes alive with vibrant colors while the city begins to light up, creating a truly magical atmosphere on the water.

More than just a tour, this is a private luxury yachting experience—perfect for couples, families, birthdays, or anyone looking to enjoy Miami in a relaxed and elevated way.
